description: Pay SOL or tokens to a destination address using the Cloaked Agent spending account. Use this for x402 payments or any transfer within the agent's spending limits.

agent_key.description: Cloaked Agent key (optional, uses env CLOAKED_AGENT_KEY if not provided)

amount.description: Amount in SOL to pay (e.g., 0.001 for 1 milliSOL, 0.1 for 100 milliSOL)

destination.description: Destination wallet address (base58 encoded Solana public key)

token.description: Token symbol (e.g., "USDC") or mint address. If omitted, pays in SOL.

name: cloak_pay
